row_mapping: r=8*g+l; r<NumWorkgroups.x=active_rows and r<inputs[0]=capacity before every output clear/store. Capacity still locates program tail and row stride.
row_ownership_argument: For 0<=active<=capacity<=65536, each active row r has unique g=floor(r/8)<active and l=r mod8. No invocation with r>=active can write. For admitted dispatch limits arithmetic is bounded below524288.
source_composition_argument: All arithmetic/guard/write functions and immutable programs remain exact. Setting the expression-owner lane to0 and execution stride1 evaluates the original complete independent layer in order. Scratch, refusal status and25 full coefficient tuples are private; every original coefficient producer,40 roots,7 RHS stages,weighted sums and final error outputs remain. Each removed barrier joined only the invocations now replaced by one ray owner. No cross-ray storage is shared.
old_failure_avoided: Do not infer active rows from capacity; use the actual unchanged Vulkan dispatch builtin. Current full-allocation C1 including nonzero inactive tails is mandatory before benefit.
scope: Source argument only, not machine-checked shader equivalence or driver/numerical/cost evidence.
